headline: Callahan’s Passage Erupts in Rapid Churn While Island Volatility Recedes
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Callahan’s Passage has erupted into the war’s foremost flashpoint, logging twelve strategic base transfers and over three thousand casualties in the past two hours as The Latch and The Crumbling Passage violently shift hands. By contrast, the frantic turnover in Fisherman’s Row has abruptly slowed, registering only two base movements and muted losses in the same interval. In the east, Weathered Expanse continues to endure tremendous upheaval, suffering nearly six thousand casualties and five base shifts across Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest. Skirmishing persists on Stlican Shelf with Breaker Town still contested, though transfers have tapered to a solitary exchange over two hours. Farther west, heavy fighting along Nevish Line has failed to alter territorial boundaries despite yielding nearly fourteen hundred fresh casualties in two hours, while Linn of Mercy, Marban Hollow, and Mooring County maintain steady attritional pressure without further strategic base changes.
